Class ErrorUtils.ErrorLog

public class ErrorUtils.ErrorLog

Builder pattern class for creating and persisting error logs. Supports both database insertion via save() and platform event publishing via publish(). Provides fluent API for setting error properties including code, message, module, type, and exception details.

Methods

public ErrorLog__c define()

Creates an ErrorLog__c record from the current builder state without persisting it. Useful for inspecting the record before saving or for custom DML operations. Outputs debug information by default.

Returns:
    ErrorLog__c: Populated error log record ready for insertion

Since:
    12/22/2025

private ErrorLog__c define(Boolean showDebug)

Creates an ErrorLog__c record from the current builder state without persisting it. Includes the current request trace ID for correlation.

Parameters:
    showDebug – true to output debug JSON, false to suppress debug output

Returns:
    ErrorLog__c: Populated error log record ready for insertion

Since:
    12/22/2025

public Boolean publish()

Publishes the error log as a platform event (ErrorLogEvent__e) for asynchronous processing. Includes current request trace ID for correlation.

Returns:
    Boolean: true if publish operation succeeded, false otherwise

public Boolean save()

Persists the error log to the ErrorLog__c object using SYSTEM_MODE access level. Includes current request trace ID for correlation.

Returns:
    Boolean: true if insert operation succeeded, false otherwise
